name: Marcus Chen
psychographics: Optimizes for time above all else; believes 'good enough' is better than perfect when it comes to meals.
current_solutions: Blue Apron for weekend cooking projects; Seamless for weekday dinners; Instacart for grocery runs on Sunday evenings.
frustration: The Seamless driver got lost in the Back Bay rotary at 6:15 PM on a Tuesday, delivered cold pad thai to the wrong apartment, and the $28 order arrived 45 minutes late despite the 'track order' feature.
decision_style: Checks 'ready in 30 minutes' filter first; if it has 4+ stars and free delivery, clicks add to cart immediately.
voice: Fast-paced, clipped sentences; uses industry jargon like 'bandwidth' and 'deliverables' even when talking about dinner; rarely uses emojis.
